data.name: depthminer
data.detailed_description:
Ultimate Player Freedom, that is what this game will provide to you. The ability to play, enjoy, and cooperate for years to come.

"You are in the Gigastructure, Level 2. Your journey is just beginning and there is so much more to explore.

The Gigastructure is an environment that can only be described by it's stories rather than what it is. Your fellow man is your biggest adversary here and without cooperation your chance of survival is a sure bet to be eaten by fleshbeasts, or slayed by those stronger than yourself. My bet is you get caught on fire, but that's just me.

Level 2 is where you begin your journey and is where you will learn the basics of survival. This is where you learn not to die. Death is permanent, so getting a chance to learn is usually fair and ideal.

Spending your time to learn what you can before venturing off into the many rooms and halls of the Gigastructure is important as each floor is comparable to a new world. You must learn and explore to get to the next.. each world has it's own ecosystem, life, people. It's usually a lot to take in, but for those who can get over it may one day get to an end."

This is not ARK, this is not Minecraft, nor RUST, this is Depthminer. Over the coming years, the game will evolve into one of the most sensible, and intense survival, sandbox mmos you will ever play and ever want to play.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Latest
  • Processor: Any ol laptop (not a chromebook)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Anything past 2012
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Do people have those still?
  • VR Support: It ain't VR!
  • Additional Notes: Brothers and Sisters, if the thing doesnt run please list your specs in the Steam Discussions so we can look into it!

developers: Richard Norman (Backend, the real talent lol)

content_descriptors.notes:
It's a top-down, 2D game where most of the player characters are 5x5 pixels. If you think something is too real, you probably need to seek professional help. 

Additionally, this is an online interactive experience. That line alone should tell you the possibilities within this game.
